format: CSV with one row per attempted joint system-environment detection trial
science_cells: all 4 input probes by 3 system bases by 3 environment bases
block_design: Every acquisition block contains all 40 cells exactly once; across each 40-block rotation superblock every cell occupies every position exactly once.
retention_rule: Every attempted trial and every no-click result is retained.
physical_requirements: coherent access to the declared environment output port
phase-referenced X and Y analysis on system and environment
Z analysis and crossed detector assignment
independently injectable identical-marker and orthogonal-marker controls
claim_boundary: Passing records certify informational completeness and environment-leakage sensitivity for the declared two-qubit port model; they do not certify an uncontrolled bath or inaccessible environment.
